description: Ministry of Sports - Order made to appoint Mr. S.E.R.T.M. Saman Priyantha Bandara as the Competent Authority of the Sri Lanka Auto Mobile Sports Association and to direct him to Convene the election to elect new Office bearers.
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (Mr. Samasundara Ekanayake...Saman Priyantha Bandara) and his title (Director General of the Department of Sports Development) while also detailing his specific responsibilities and powers as the appointed Competent Authority for the Sri Lanka Auto Mobile Sports Association, including convening elections. This combination of a named person with detailed responsibilities qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
